requirement.statement: cozo-wiki SHALL allow semantic search callers to restrict results to a caller-provided set of source categories.

case.given: The repository database has indexed code symbol embeddings and documentation block embeddings
case.when: A caller searches with the docs category selected
case.then: The semantic search result SHALL only include documentation source hits

case.given: The repository database has indexed code symbol embeddings and documentation block embeddings
case.when: A caller searches with the code category selected
case.then: The semantic search result SHALL only include code source hits

case.given: A caller does not provide any source categories
case.then: The semantic search result SHALL preserve the prior all-source behavior

requirement.statement: cozo-wiki SHALL expose a bounded project overview graph so the visualization workbench can show repository structure before the user runs a search.

case.given: The cozo-wiki server is connected to a work directory with an existing CodeKnowledge database
case.when: The user clicks the load overview graph action in the visualization workbench
case.then: The workbench SHALL render a graph assembled from repository, file, code symbol, documentation block, and relation facts without requiring a prior search

case.given: The repository contains many indexed facts
case.then: The server SHALL return a bounded graph with truncation metadata rather than an unbounded full dump

case.given: The user has selected code and docs category controls
case.then: The graph SHALL include only the selected category families while preserving useful containment and relation edges between included nodes
